info.name: ShopSecure Backend API
info.description: Legacy V15 reference collection retained for unchanged authentication, wallet, admin, and webhook utilities. Its order and waybill onboarding folders are superseded and must not be run. Use ShopSecure V19 Carrier Pickup Settlement and Shipping Control.postman_collection.json for current behavior.

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: Register and verify a new account, or log into an existing verified account. Paste OTP values into the selected environment before verification requests.

request.description: Creates an unverified account and emails a six-digit OTP. No JWT, wallet, or virtual account exists until verification succeeds.
Wait at least 60 seconds after the previous OTP. A new challenge invalidates the old one.
Enables the account, provisions the wallet and Paystack DVA, and saves the returned JWT.
Always returns the same accepted response. Paste the emailed code into passwordResetOtp.
Invalidates previously issued JWTs and updates memberPassword in the selected Postman environment. Log in again afterward.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.wallet) pm.environment.set('walletBalance', data.wallet.balance); if (data.virtualAccount) pm.environment.set('virtualAccountNumber', data.virtualAccount.accountNumber); }

request.description: PATCH semantics are replace-like here: firstname, lastname, and phoneNumber are all required.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length) pm.environment.set('shippingStateCode', data[0].code); }

request.description: Returns the backend-cached Nigerian state catalogue. Use code only for the city lookup and submit name in address payloads.
Returns cached cities for a state code returned by the states request. Submit a selected city name in address payloads.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length) pm.environment.set('bankCode', data[0].code); }

item.name: 03 - Buyer-Created Wallet Order
item.description: The authenticated member is the buyer. The guest vendor supplies payout and parcel details. The member selects shipping, pays from wallet, and confirms delivery; Paystack then pays the guest vendor.

request.description: Buyer-created orders must omit parcel. The response fundingMode should be WALLET.
The guest vendor must provide both a resolved payout account and parcel details. Paste the delivered OTP into buyerCounterpartyOtp.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('buyerGuestAccessToken', data.guestAccessToken); pm.environment.set('activeShareToken', pm.environment.get('buyerShareToken')); pm.environment.set('activeGuestAccessToken', data.guestAccessToken); }

request.description: Verification also creates the guest vendor's Paystack transfer recipient.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('At least one quote is available', () => pm.expect(data.length).to.be.above(0)); if (data.length) pm.environment.set('buyerQuoteId', data[0].quoteId); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.pricing) pm.environment.set('buyerOrderTotal', data.pricing.totalAmount); }

request.description: INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS performs no debit. After a DVA top-up is credited, set a new buyerWalletPaymentKey for the new intentional payment attempt and send again.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Buyer order includes reusable share link', () => pm.expect(data.shareableLink).to.eql(pm.environment.get('buyerShareableLink'))); if (data.shipping) { pm.environment.set('trackingReference', data.shipping.trackingReference || ''); pm.environment.set('trackingUrl', data.shipping.trackingUrl || ''); const ref = data.shipping.trackingReference || ''; if (ref.startsWith('TRK-MOCK-')) pm.environment.set('stubShipmentId', ref.replace('TRK-MOCK-', 'SHP-MOCK-')); } }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('trackingReference', data.trackingReference || ''); pm.environment.set('trackingUrl', data.trackingUrl || ''); const ref = data.trackingReference || ''; if (ref.startsWith('TRK-MOCK-')) pm.environment.set('stubShipmentId', ref.replace('TRK-MOCK-', 'SHP-MOCK-')); }

request.description: Initiates payout of itemAmount to the guest vendor. A pending response is normal; poll details or use the controlled payout webhook helper in local/test.

item.name: 04 - Vendor-Created Checkout Order
item.description: The authenticated member is the vendor and supplies parcel details. The verified guest buyer selects shipping, pays through Paystack Checkout, and confirms delivery with an OTP. Settlement credits the member vendor's wallet.

request.description: Vendor-created orders require parcel and use PAYSTACK_CHECKOUT funding.
Guest buyers must omit externalBankAccount and parcel. Paste the delivered OTP into vendorCounterpartyOtp.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('vendorGuestAccessToken', data.guestAccessToken); pm.environment.set('activeShareToken', pm.environment.get('vendorShareToken')); pm.environment.set('activeGuestAccessToken', data.guestAccessToken); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('At least one quote is available', () => pm.expect(data.length).to.be.above(0)); if (data.length) pm.environment.set('vendorQuoteId', data[0].quoteId); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.pricing) pm.environment.set('vendorOrderTotal', data.pricing.totalAmount); }

request.description: Open checkoutAuthorizationUrl and complete payment. A browser callback is not payment proof; poll status until the backend verifies payment.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('trackingReference', data.trackingReference || ''); pm.environment.set('trackingUrl', data.trackingUrl || ''); const ref = data.trackingReference || ''; if (ref.startsWith('TRK-MOCK-')) pm.environment.set('stubShipmentId', ref.replace('TRK-MOCK-', 'SHP-MOCK-')); }

request.description: The order must be READY_FOR_DELIVERY. Paste the delivered code into deliveryOtp.
Credits itemAmount to the registered vendor wallet exactly once.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Vendor order includes reusable share link', () => pm.expect(data.shareableLink).to.eql(pm.environment.get('vendorShareableLink'))); }

item.name: 05 - Order and Guest Utilities
item.description: General list, access recovery, and cancellation requests. Set activeShareToken and activeGuestAccessToken by running either workflow's OTP verification request.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Creator orders include reusable share links', () => { pm.expect(data.content).to.be.an('array'); data.content.forEach(order => { pm.expect(order.shareableLink).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(order.shareableLink.length).to.be.above(0); }); }); }

request.description: Returns creator-owned orders newest first. Every content item includes shareableLink so the creator can copy the order link again.
No previous guest token is required. Paste the code into accessRecoveryOtp.
Saves the replacement token as activeGuestAccessToken and revokes older active guest tokens.

item.name: 06 Cancel Buyer Order Before Payment (alternative path)

request.description: Do not run during the main flow. Cancellation is available only before confirmed payment and may return an empty body when no shipment exists.

item.name: 07 Cancel Vendor Order Before Checkout (alternative path)

request.description: Do not run during the main flow. Once a Checkout URL has been initialized, cancellation requires manual review and this request is rejected.

item.name: 06 - Signed Webhook Helpers (local/test only)
item.description: Synthetic provider callbacks for a controlled local or test backend. Scripts calculate signatures over the exact rendered body. Never use these requests against production.

exec: if (!secret) throw new Error('Set paystackWebhookSecret to the backend test Paystack key');

request.description: Credits walletTopUpAmountMinor/100 to the wallet owning virtualAccountNumber. Run Get Wallet afterward, create a new buyerWalletPaymentKey, then retry wallet payment.

exec: if (!secret) throw new Error('Set paystackWebhookSecret to the backend test Paystack key');
if (!pm.environment.get('checkoutReference') || !pm.environment.get('checkoutAmountMinor')) throw new Error('Initialize Checkout first');

request.description: Marks the persisted checkout attempt paid only when reference, exact amount, and currency match.

exec: if (!secret) throw new Error('Set paystackWebhookSecret to the backend test Paystack key');
if (!pm.environment.get('payoutReference')) throw new Error('Create, fund, and carrier-pickup an order first');

request.description: Completes the initial deterministic payout reference. If automated reconciliation created a retry reference, update payoutReference before sending.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('stubShipmentId')) throw new Error('Refresh tracking first so stubShipmentId can be derived');

request.description: For application-local with Terminal disabled. The endpoint delegates to StubShippingProvider and expects HMAC-SHA256 in x-shipping-signature.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('terminalShipmentId')) throw new Error('Set terminalShipmentId from the provider dashboard/logs');

request.description: For the TerminalAfricaShippingProvider only. Uses HMAC-SHA512 in X-Terminal-Signature.

item.name: 07 - Waybill Creator
item.description: Authenticated waybill creation and creator-owned reads/mutations. Invited-payer creation contains only sender pickup details; the verified recipient controls quotes and checkout. Creator-paid creation includes both parties, and the creator controls quotes and checkout.

request.description: Creates PARTY_COMPLETION access for the missing RECIPIENT and lets that verified invitee pay. Reusing the same key/body returns 201 with replayed=true and no invitationLink.

body.raw:
{
  "creatorRole": "SENDER",
  "payerType": "CREATOR",
  "description": "{{waybillDescription}}",
  "declaredValue": {{waybillDeclaredValue}},
  "creatorAddress": {
    "line1": "1 Marina Road",
    "line2": null,
    "city": "Lagos",
    "state": "Lagos",
    "country": "NG",
    "postalCode": "100001"
  },
  "parcel": {
    "weightKg": 2.500,
    "lengthCm": 40.00,
    "widthCm": 30.00,
    "heightCm": 15.00
  },
  "oppositeParty": {
    "firstName": "{{waybillPartyFirstName}}",
    "lastName": "{{waybillPartyLastName}}",
    "email": "{{waybillPartyEmail}}",
    "phoneNumber": "{{waybillPartyPhone}}",
    "address": {
      "line1": "2 Receiver Road",
      "line2": null,
      "city": "Abuja",
      "state": "FCT",
      "country": "NG",
      "postalCode": "900001"
    }
  }
}

request.description: Alternative combination: both parties exist immediately, payerType is CREATOR, initial status is AWAITING_QUOTE, and no invitation is issued.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Page envelope is present', () => { pm.expect(data.content).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.page).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(data.size).to.be.a('number'); }); }

request.description: Zero-based creator-owned page, sorted by createdAt then id descending.
Bare array ordered oldest first.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('waybillInvitationLink', data.invitationLink); const segments = data.invitationLink.split('/').filter(Boolean); pm.environment.set('waybillInvitationToken', segments[segments.length - 1]); pm.environment.unset('waybillAccessToken'); }

request.description: Revokes the prior recipient invitation/access token and captures one replacement PARTY_COMPLETION link. Valid only while the waybill is still AWAITING_PARTY_DETAILS.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.length) pm.environment.set('creatorPayWaybillQuoteId', data[0].quoteId); }
pm.test('Creator waybill checkout initialized or replayed', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('creatorPayWaybillCheckoutReference', data.reference); pm.environment.set('creatorPayWaybillAuthorizationUrl', data.authorizationUrl || ''); }

request.description: No body. Valid only for payerType CREATOR. Reuse this key while the attempt is open.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('waybillProviderShipmentId', data.providerShipmentId || ''); pm.environment.set('waybillTrackingReference', data.trackingReference || ''); }

request.description: Creator-only live provider refresh. The shipment must already exist.
Alternative terminal path. Reuse the same key and reason; persisted scheduler/backoff handles due carrier retries and full captured-payment refunds.

item.name: 08 - Waybill Public Invitation
item.description: Recipient onboarding, OTP verification, quote selection, and invited checkout. Select no authentication for every request and use the invitation-scoped access token after OTP verification.

request.description: PARTY_COMPLETION only. Sends one code to the same normalized phone and email. Paste it into waybillOtp.
Wait at least 60 seconds. Replace waybillOtp with the newly delivered code.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('waybillAccessToken', data.accessToken); pm.environment.set('waybillPublicId', data.waybillPublicId); }

request.description: Captures the one-time plaintext accessToken. PARTY_COMPLETION moves the root to AWAITING_QUOTE.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Status never reissues plaintext access', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().accessToken).to.eql(null));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('At least one waybill quote is available', () => pm.expect(data.length).to.be.above(0)); if (data.length) { pm.environment.set('waybillQuoteId', data[0].quoteId); pm.environment.set('waybillQuoteExpiresAt', data[0].expiresAt); } }

request.description: Requires the active verified recipient PARTY_COMPLETION invitation with canPay=true and completed recipient details. Reuses cached unexpired rates.
Freezes pricing, sets paymentDueAt, and moves the waybill to AWAITING_PAYMENT/PENDING. Repeating the same selected quote is idempotent only while the quote and payment window remain unexpired.
No old access token or body is required, but the raw invitation must still be active and previously verified. Paste the code into waybillRecoveryOtp.
Captures the replacement access token and immediately revokes the old one.

exec: pm.test('Invited waybill checkout initialized or replayed', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('waybillCheckoutReference', data.reference); pm.environment.set('waybillAuthorizationUrl', data.authorizationUrl || ''); pm.environment.set('waybillCheckoutAccessCode', data.accessCode || ''); pm.environment.set('waybillCheckoutAmountMinor', Math.round(Number(data.amount) * 100)); }

request.description: Run after the verified recipient selects a quote. No body. Reuse this key while the attempt is open; authorizationUrl/accessCode can be null for INITIALIZATION_UNKNOWN. After matched funding, refresh status because invited payment access is closed.

item.name: 09 - Waybill Admin
item.description: Read-only V14 waybill operations. Set adminJwt from a verified ADMIN login. The numeric adminWaybillId is captured from the list and is not the public UUID.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.content && data.content.length) { pm.environment.set('adminWaybillId', data.content[0].id); pm.environment.set('adminWaybillCreatorId', data.content[0].creatorId); } }

request.description: Zero-based, numeric ID descending page. Optional filters are creatorId, status, and paymentStatus.

exec: pm.test('Filtered admin waybill page returned', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Filters are combined with AND. Omit a filter rather than setting it to an empty string.
Returns the exact nested admin waybill DTO. Each operational collection is newest first and capped at 100; parties are role-ordered.
